Japanese Prime Minister Receives Ceremonial Welcome in India

Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has arrived in India and received a ceremonial welcome from the Indian government. This visit marks the first time a Japanese prime minister has visited India, and it is seen as an opportunity for both countries to strengthen their bilateral relations. The visit coincides with the 16th Annual Summit of the Japan-India Economic Partnership Agreement.
